summary: Implemented the desktop Seeker request list and request details for SEK-02, SEK-03, and SEK-04. The feature consumes the authenticated request list and detail contracts, preserves pagination and ownership scoping, renders localized safe projections and status timelines, and fails closed for unavailable sessions and IDOR/not-found responses without exposing internal assignments, notes, audit fields, or private metadata.

No production mocks, production data, secrets, or real .env contents were read.
